hooks.command: cat | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+push' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER (git push hook): You just ran a git push. The GitHub Actions CI gate starts now and it controls deployment to Cloudflare Pages. Do NOT sit and wait for it in the foreground. Instead launch a background CI watcher and return control: get the newest run id via gh run list for the current branch, then run gh run watch with that id and --exit-status using run_in_background true. You will be auto-notified when CI finishes, so keep working or hand back control meanwhile."}}' || true
hooks.statusMessage: Recordatorio: vigilar el CI en background
